# Lantern explanation outcomes comparison

| Period | Logical explanation requests (denominator) | Eligible combined explanations | Valid over-24-hour separations | Explicit-unknown outcomes | Eligible renderer failures |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| July 1–September 18, 2025 | 463 | 307 | 103 | 53 | 0 |
| October 1–December 15, 2027 | 651 | 431 | 145 | 75 | 0 |

In both periods, the three explanation outcomes reconcile to all logical requests. The 2027 package had 188 more requests; combined explanations, valid separations, and explicit-unknown outcomes each increased, while eligible renderer failures remained zero.
